title: DarkX Universal Aimbot Silent Aim
features:
📌 Overview
Clean, smooth, and undetectable. DarkX Aimbot gives you the edge in any Roblox game with a simple, modern interface and zero bloat. Just load it up, tweak your settings, and start dominating.

✨ Features
Silent Aim – Redirect bullets without moving your camera (clean & smooth)

Aimbot Toggle – Turn it on/off whenever you want

Hitbox Selection – Head, Torso, or Random

Prediction – Adjustable velocity-based targeting

FOV Circle – See your lock-on range (customizable size)

Wall Check – Only locks when target is visible

Team Check – Avoids locking onto teammates

Bullet Tracer – Clean vertical line on your target

Target Info – Shows who you're locked onto with their profile pic

Smooth Aim – Adjustable smoothness so it looks natural

All settings are adjustable in real-time through a clean, dark UI that you can drag anywhere.

🎮 How It Works
The script scans for nearby enemies, checks if they're visible (if you have wall check on), and locks onto them based on your FOV and hitbox settings. Silent aim lets you track targets without moving your camera – making it much harder to spot.

Prediction helps you lead shots on moving targets. Just slide the bar to find what feels right for the game you're playing.

🔧 Settings You Can Tweak
Prediction strength (0 to 0.5)

FOV radius (0 to 500)

Smoothness (0 to 100)

Hitbox (Head / Torso / Random)

Toggle wall check on/off

Toggle team check on/off

Toggle silent aim on/off

Toggle tracer on/off

Toggle FOV circle on/off
